description: This Java source file defines a custom ArrayAdapter called StableArrayAdapter for an Android application. It manages a stable ID mapping for list items and sets a touch listener on list item views for handling user interactions, likely related to swipe removal animations.

classes.name: StableArrayAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter that assigns stable IDs to list items and attaches a touch listener to each item view to enable swipe gesture detection or other touch interactions.

methods.name: StableArrayAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with context, layout resource ID, list of objects, and a touch listener. It also maps each object's string to its index to ensure stable item IDs.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the stable ID for the item at the specified position based on the precomputed hash map.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter's item IDs are stable.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Overrides the default getView to attach an OnTouchListener to each view item, enabling touch interactions such as swipe gestures.
